hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail
# Parameters expected: # managed_inputs (S3 URI) # s3_bucket (bucket name) # role_arn (IAM role ARN) # session_name (string) # jars_dir (default: jars) # upload_suffix (default: empty)
mkdir -p data/decoded completed processing logs find data -type f -delete || true find processing -type f -delete || true find completed -type f -delete || true find logs -type f -delete || true
# Assume role and fetch Managed_Inputs.csv aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 900 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
aws s3 cp "${managed_inputs}" ./Managed_Inputs.csv unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
csvcut -c "Study Abbreviated Name","Study Identifier","Study Type","Data is ready to process","Data Processed","Has Multi","Use Manual Table Methods" Managed_Inputs.csv > inputs.csv
# Fetch decoded inputs and existing mappings per-study IFS=',' tail -n +2 inputs.csv | while read abv_name stdy_id stdy_type data_ready data_processed has_multi has_tables; do abv_name=$(echo "$abv_name" | tr -d '"') stdy_id=$(echo "$stdy_id" | tr -d '"') stdy_type_lc=$(echo "$stdy_type" | tr -d '"' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') data_ready_lc=$(echo "$data_ready" | tr -d '"' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') data_processed_lc=$(echo "$data_processed" | tr -d '"' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
if [[ "$data_ready_lc" == yes && "$data_processed_lc" == no ]]; then if [[ "$stdy_type_lc" == imaging ]]; then echo "Preparing inputs for ${abv_name} (${stdy_id})"
aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
aws s3 cp "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${abv_name,,}/decoded_data/" data/decoded/ \ --recursive --exclude "*" \ --include "${stdy_id}*.Subject.MULTI.txt" \ --include "${stdy_id}*.Sample.MULTI.txt" --no-progress || true
aws s3 cp "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${abv_name,,}/data/${abv_name^^}_PatientMapping.v2.csv" "data/${abv_name^^}_PatientMapping.v2.csv" --no-progress || \ aws s3 cp "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${abv_name,,}/mappings/${stdy_id}/PatientMapping.v2.csv" "data/${abv_name^^}_PatientMapping.v2.csv" --no-progress || \ aws s3 cp "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${abv_name,,}/mappings/${abv_name^^}_PatientMapping.v2.csv" "data/${abv_name^^}_PatientMapping.v2.csv" --no-progress || true
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN fi fi
done
# Strip any BOMs and run the augmenter if ls data/decoded/* 1> /dev/null 2>&1; then sed -i '1s/^\xEF\xBB\xBF//' data/decoded/* || true fi cp Managed_Inputs.csv data/Managed_Inputs.csv
java -jar jars/SubjectSampleConsentAugmenter.jar -datadir ./data/ \ -managedinputsfile ./data/Managed_Inputs.csv \ -trialid DEFAULT \ > logs/augmenter.log 2>&1
echo "Disabled upload for testing." exit 0; # Upload augmented mappings IFS=',' tail -n +2 inputs.csv | while read abv_name stdy_id stdy_type data_ready data_processed has_multi has_tables; do abv_name=$(echo "$abv_name" | tr -d '"') stdy_id=$(echo "$stdy_id" | tr -d '"') stdy_type_lc=$(echo "$stdy_type" | tr -d '"' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') data_ready_lc=$(echo "$data_ready" | tr -d '"' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') data_processed_lc=$(echo "$data_processed" | tr -d '"' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
if [[ "$data_ready_lc" == yes && "$data_processed_lc" == no ]]; then if [[ "$stdy_type_lc" != parent && "$stdy_type_lc" != topmed && "$stdy_type_lc" != substudy && "$stdy_type_lc" != shhs && "$stdy_type_lc" != imaging ]]; then mapping_file="data/${abv_name^^}_PatientMapping.v2.csv" if [[ -f "$mapping_file" ]]; then echo "Uploading augmented mapping for ${abv_name} (${stdy_id})" aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
aws s3 cp "$mapping_file" "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${abv_name,,}/mappings/${stdy_id}/${abv_name^^}_PatientMapping.v2${upload_suffix}.csv" --no-progress || true ts=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S) aws s3 cp "$mapping_file" "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${abv_name,,}/mappings/${stdy_id}/backups/${abv_name^^}_PatientMapping.v2_${ts}.csv" --no-progress || true
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN else echo "WARNING: Missing mapping file $mapping_file — nothing to upload for ${abv_name} (${stdy_id})." fi fi fi
done
